title: dotfiles install config
description: Overlays config/default.json. Arrays replace, objects merge.

modules.description: Package modules: each key is packages/<key>.txt. base, aur and exclude cannot be listed. "auto" means true (kept for compatibility).

extra_packages.description: Packages on top of the modules, for this machine or this config only.

scope.description: user: no root needed (default). system: installs for all users with sudo.

hardware.description: Install the packages/hardware/ lists that match the detected CPU, GPUs and battery (default true).

fonts.description: Nerd Fonts from packages/fonts/nerd-fonts.txt: "ask" (pick from a list once, remembered; run `dot fonts` to change), "all", "none", or a list of package names.

greeter.description: "keep" (default): leave the login screen archinstall set up alone. Or a package whose systemd service has the same name (e.g. "sddm", "greetd") to install and enable when no other greeter is enabled.
